name: Zhongji Innolight Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhongji Innolight Co., Ltd. research and development, design, manufacturing, and sales of high-speed optical transceivers in China, United States, Singapore, Netherlands, United Kingdom, and Hong Kong. The company offers products, such as a comprehensive portfolio of optical transceivers from 10G to 1.6T, including modules for 400G, 800G, and 1.6T applications; components in optical transceivers and related optical communication equipment, including Transistor Outline Can (TO-CAN) packaged components; and in-vehicle optical transmission solutions for fiber to the vehicle (FTTV) deployment.
